description: Parking à vélos - commune d'Annecy is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Annecy. This dataset gathers the different bicycle parking spaces of the city of Annecy. It centralizes information on the types of hooks used by these car parks, their address, their capacity and their precise geolocation. Coverage: Ville d'Annecy. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle parking - municipality of Annecy" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Annecy. Its keywords include transport-mobilite, annecy, mobilitedouce, challenge-data, velo, transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, PDF. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
